mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.contentid, d.contenttypeid, d.title, d.addr1, d.firstimage2, NVL(d.addr1, s.SIGNGU_NAME) AS regionName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND contenttypeid != 15 AND contenttypeid != 25 ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(contentid) ASC ) d LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON d.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND d.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND contenttypeid != 15 AND contenttypeid != 25

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id AS plnId, p.pln_title AS plnTitle, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.total_days AS totalDays, p.m_id AS mId, m.m_nickname AS memberNickname, p.lDongRegnCd, p.lDongSignguCd, CASE WHEN p.lDongRegnCd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE p.lDongRegnCd WHEN '11' THEN '서울' WHEN '26' THEN '부산' WHEN '27' THEN '대구' WHEN '28' THEN '인천' WHEN '29' THEN '광주' WHEN '30' THEN '대전' WHEN '31' THEN '울산' WHEN '36' THEN '세종' WHEN '41' THEN '경기' WHEN '42' THEN '강원' WHEN '43' THEN '충북' WHEN '44' THEN '충남' WHEN '45' THEN '전북' WHEN '46' THEN '전남' WHEN '47' THEN '경북' WHEN '48' THEN '경남' WHEN '50' THEN '제주' WHEN '51' THEN '강원' WHEN '52' THEN '전북' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END AS sidoName, NVL(s.SIGNGU_NAME, '') AS signguName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC ) p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1
